_comment: #574 -- the .NET PDF library SecurityInsight renders its mail PDFs with: PDFsharp + MigraDoc 6.2.4 (MIT, verified on the nuspec of this exact version: <license type="expression">MIT</license>; https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT) and its two Microsoft.Extensions dependencies (MIT). Never QuestPDF. ONE pinned list for every consumer: container/Install-SIPdfLibrary.ps1 downloads exactly these packages at image build and refuses any whose SHA-512 differs; engine/_shared/SI-MailPdf.ps1 finds the DLLs by these names; engine/_shared/pdf/SI.Pdf.csproj references the same versions (a test keeps them equal). Only the managed DLLs listed here are copied -- no native code, no executable, no PowerShell module.
